import numpy as np, csv, math
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('invasion_success_pathways.csv'),delimiter='\t'))
print(len(rows), rows[0]['intro.pathway'])
def f(x):
    try: return float(x)
    except: return None
data=[]
for r in rows:
    if r['Scientific_name'] is None or r['Scientific_name']=='' : continue
    data.append(r)
print(len(data))
# OLS helper
def ols(y,X,names):
    y=np.array(y,dtype=float); X=np.array(X,dtype=float)
    beta,res,rank,sv=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)
    yhat=X@beta; e=y-yhat
    n,k=X.shape
    sigma2=e@e/(n-k)
    XtXi=np.linalg.inv(X.T@X)
    se=np.sqrt(np.diag(XtXi)*sigma2)
    t=beta/se
    ss_tot=((y-y.mean())**2).sum(); r2=1-(e@e)/ss_tot
    return dict(zip(names,beta)), dict(zip(names,se)), dict(zip(names,t)), r2, n

# main regressions
y=[f(r['number.of.invaded.plots']) for r in data]
y2=[f(r['area.of.occupancy.10km']) for r in data]
mrt=[f(r['mrt']) for r in data]
pw=[r['intro.pathway'] for r in data]
height=[f(r['height']) for r in data]
gf=[r['growth.form'] for r in data]
mrtc=np.array(mrt)-np.mean(mrt)
d_un=[1 if p=='Unintentional' else 0 for p in pw]
d_ga=[1 if p=='Gardening' else 0 for p in pw]
d_ag=[1 if p=='AgriForest' else 0 for p in pw]

def build(yvar, logt=False):
    yy=[]
    for v in yvar: yy.append(math.log(v+1) if logt else v)
    X=[[1,m,d_un[i],d_ga[i],m*d_un[i],m*d_ga[i]] for i,m in enumerate(mrtc)]
    names=['const','mrt_c','Unint','Gardening','mrt_c:Unint','mrt_c:Gardening']
    return yy,X,names

for lab,yvar,logt in [('num.plots',y,False),('log num.plots',y,True),('area',y2,False)]:
    yy,X,names=build(yvar,logt)
    b,se,t,r2,n=ols(yy,X,names)
    print(lab,{k:round(v,4) for k,v in b.items()},'se',{k:round(v,4) for k,v in se.items()},'t',{k:round(v,3) for k,v in t.items()},'R2',round(r2,4),'n',n)

print('--- means by pathway')
for p in ['AgriForest','Gardening','Unintentional']:
    idx=[i for i,r in enumerate(data) if r['intro.pathway']==p]
    for col in ['number.of.invaded.plots','area.of.occupancy.10km','habitat.range','invaded.niche.breadth','mrt','native.niche.breadth','height']:
        v=[f(data[i][col]) for i in idx]
        print(p,col,'mean',round(np.mean(v),4),'median',round(np.median(v),4),'n',len(v))
print('--- percent change unint vs gardening num plots')
a=[f(r['number.of.invaded.plots']) for r in data if r['intro.pathway']=='Unintentional']
b2=[f(r['number.of.invaded.plots']) for r in data if r['intro.pathway']=='Gardening']
print(np.mean(a),np.mean(b2),(np.mean(a)-np.mean(b2))/np.mean(b2))
aa=[f(r['area.of.occupancy.10km']) for r in data if r['intro.pathway']=='Unintentional']
bb=[f(r['area.of.occupancy.10km']) for r in data if r['intro.pathway']=='Gardening']
print('area',np.mean(aa),np.mean(bb),(np.mean(aa)-np.mean(bb))/np.mean(bb))
# median ratio

mm_g=[f(r['mrt']) for r in data if r['intro.pathway']=='Gardening']
